answer: Make each identity earn its keep through a chained delay harvest: before answering, it must finish a sequential verifiable-delay puzzle seeded by its own previous epoch answer, taking about an hour of wall-clock time that no parallel hardware can shorten — a farm of a thousand clones needs a thousand hours, not one. The seed is timber from the last epoch, so copied answers break the chain, and a juniper of slow-growing trust marks identities that finish on time. Any relic of a broken chain stays public, so graders spot a farm replaying yesterday's work and slash its rewards to zero.
